message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Only one evaluated design exists (direct, coef_frac=15, rne) and it already meets the 60 dB SQNR quality bar. Since quality is satisfied, the best next move is to reduce mapped area by lowering coefficient fractional precision, which has a legal unvisited neighbor available. This trades a small amount of numerical margin for area while keeping the quality verdict likely intact."}
